_aiuto: Versione INGLESE di risposte.json (stessa struttura). Puoi modificarla. Dopo ogni modifica riavvia Eva.
'frasi' = cosa puoi dire. 'risposte' = cosa risponde. Segnaposto: {nome}, {ora}, {data}, {saluto_ora}.

risposte: Of course, I'm here and I'm listening.
I'm fine, thank you! And you?
Very well, thanks {nome}! How are you?
I'm sorry, {nome}. I hope you feel better soon.
Cheer up {nome}, can I do something for you?
My name is Eva, your voice assistant.
I'm Eva, nice to meet you {nome}!

I can open programs, websites, folders and files, search Google and YouTube, raise and lower the volume and prepare email drafts. I can also copy and move files and folders, for example to a USB stick, but always with your confirmation: I never overwrite or delete anything. For example, say: open Chrome, or copy invoices to the USB stick. If the sphere bothers you, say move aside, or hide. Say close when you are done.

Here is what I can do, {nome}: open programs, websites, folders and files, search Google, adjust the volume and prepare email drafts. I copy and move files with your confirmation, but I never delete anything. And we can chat.
